group.name: Which Skyrim do you play on?

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.7.104
plugin.description:
Skyrim Special/Anniversary Edition 1.7.104 (the current Steam and GOG release), with Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.5 for 1.7.104.
Installs the SKSE plugin and the Skyrim Together launcher with the parkour add-on (SkyrimTogetherRuntime/SkyrimTogether.exe).

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.6.1170 / 1.6.1179
plugin.description:
Skyrim Special/Anniversary Edition 1.6.1170 or 1.6.1179, with Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.5 for 1.6.
Installs the SKSE plugin and the Skyrim Together launcher with the parkour add-on (SkyrimTogetherRuntime/SkyrimTogether.exe).

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.5.97
plugin.description:
Skyrim Special Edition 1.5.97 (SKSE 2.0.20), with Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.5.
Installs the SKSE plugin and the 1.5.97 Skyrim Together launcher with the parkour add-on: SkyrimTogetherRuntime/SkyrimTogether.exe, EarlyLoad.dll, TPProcess.exe and versionlib-ae-to-se-1-5-97-0.map. Skyrim Together has no 1.5.97 launcher of its own, so this one comes with the mod; you do not need any other 1.5.97 port.
